recommendation.title: Create a curated in-stock discovery collection to encourage larger baskets
recommendation.summary: Use existing active, in-stock products to create a clearly merchandised multi-product discovery surface, beginning with the proven bestseller Borderlands Discovery Four and complementary products selected from the currently available range.
recommendation.whyThisAction: The supplied evidence shows 27 of 50 trailing-90-day orders contained exactly one item and only 3 contained at least four items. Shopify currently has a focused catalogue with 17 active products and substantial positive inventory, so merchandising existing products is more reversible than introducing new catalogue complexity.
recommendation.whyNow: The current Shopify read confirms the relevant products are active and available now: Borderlands Discovery Four has totalInventory 61, Cloud Needle Tsolikouri 222, Bora Line Rebula 176, Meadow Clock 25, and Cedar Ink 112. There is an existing Bundles collection, but it contains only 2 products, leaving room for a distinct discovery-led merchandising surface.
recommendation.startToday: Give single-item shoppers a lower-friction path to add another product, increasing multi-item orders and average basket depth without adding products or changing prices.

successSignal.scope: A new manual collection containing a small, merchant-reviewed set of existing active products with positive available inventory. The collection should be linked from relevant product or storefront merchandising surfaces after review.
successSignal.mechanism: A focused, in-stock discovery surface can reduce the effort required for a shopper who has selected one product to consider an additional product, converting some single-item purchases into multi-item baskets.
constraints: Do not create new SKUs, alter product prices, apply discounts, or change inventory.
Do not include products whose total available inventory is 0 or below.
The product pairing is a merchandising hypothesis, not a Shopify-confirmed customer-affinity relationship; the merchant should review the final product set before publishing.
The read found 2 active variants at zero inventory, so eligibility must be evaluated at the selected product/variant level rather than assuming every variant is available.
The current collections include an existing Bundles collection with 2 products; avoid duplicating those products unless the new collection has a distinct discovery purpose.

Recheck multi-item order share and median items per order after a meaningful selling period.

candidateQueue.diagnosedProblem: 13 of 17 active products declined in revenue in the current 30-day period versus the prior 30 days, while the store has had no stored order in the last 7 days and its latest stored order was 19 days ago.
candidateQueue.operationQuery: Create or revise a dedicated collection and storefront merchandising placement for currently declining but in-stock products, subject to product-level verification. 13 of 17 active products declined in revenue in the current 30-day period versus the prior 30 days, while the store has had no stored order in the last 7 days and its latest stored order was 19 days ago.
candidateQueue.reason: Shopify confirms the catalogue is active and largely in stock: 17 active products were returned, with positive total inventory for the products read, including Rain Map Tannat at 71 units. The collection read shows existing collections such as All Wine, New Arrivals, and category collections, but no clearly dedicated declining-products collection. However, Shopify state does not provide the product-level current-versus-prior-30-day revenue predicate required to safely select the 13 declining products. The aggregate Merchant Memory evidence (d62acc84-d0e3-4cce-9c8d-aea843f55e67) identifies 13 declining products but does not identify all qualifying product IDs. Creating a collection or placement without that list would risk including non-declining products, so the proposed intervention cannot be safely encoded yet.
